# Atelier Cloud

> Atelier Cloud runs PhotoCraft and PdfCraft in the browser tab. Documents are opened from the
> visitor's own machine and edited there: no upload, no account. PdfCraft is the PDF workbench, and
> the tutorials below are short, tested walkthroughs for it.

## What PdfCraft does in the browser

- Combine files into one PDF, split a document, and reorder or delete pages.
- Fill interactive PDF forms and place a typed, drawn or scanned signature.
- Redact text and images, then rewrite the file so the removed content is gone.
- Encrypt a PDF with a password, and restrict printing, copying and changes.
- Stamp page numbers into the footer, and flatten a filled form into page content.
- Recognise text in scans, reduce file size, and export to Word, PowerPoint, HTML or text.

## Tutorials

- [Add page numbers to a PDF](https://ateliercloud.eu/blog/add-page-numbers-to-a-pdf): Stamp page numbers into the footer of every page, and flatten a filled form so the values become part of the page.
- [Fill in and sign a PDF form](https://ateliercloud.eu/blog/fill-and-sign-a-pdf-form): Fill interactive PDF forms, add free text, and place a signature in the browser. The document never leaves your machine.
- [Merge and split PDFs in the browser](https://ateliercloud.eu/blog/merge-and-split-pdfs): Combine several PDFs into one file, or cut one PDF into parts, without installing anything or uploading the documents.
- [Password protect a PDF](https://ateliercloud.eu/blog/password-protect-a-pdf): Encrypt a PDF with a password in the browser, and decide what a reader may print, copy or change. The file is never uploaded.
- [Redact a PDF before you share it](https://ateliercloud.eu/blog/redact-a-pdf-before-sharing): Black out names, addresses and account numbers, and remove the text underneath from the file itself.
